headline: Clinton order makes changes to two earlier orders that set up the American Heritage Rivers program and its advisory committee.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Orders 13061 and 13080. Those earlier orders created the American Heritage Rivers program, which picks certain rivers for extra federal help to support local river communities, and set up an advisory committee for it. No summary of the specific changes was provided, so the details of what was amended are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Communities along rivers named American Heritage Rivers
who_it_affects.how: Changes to the program's rules may affect how these communities are chosen or get federal help.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies taking part in the river program
who_it_affects.how: The agencies may have to follow updated rules for how the program is run.
